houston.label: Downtown / Midtown
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from City of Houston Super Neighborhood/management district boundaries; seed-only in LP035
houston.consumerRationale: Recognizable central activity core for commuters, events, and civic trips.

houston.label: Heights / Near Northside
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from Super Neighborhood boundaries with separately owned communities clipped out
houston.consumerRationale: Common inner-north label around I-10, I-45, Yale/Heights, and North Main corridors.

houston.label: Montrose / Museum District
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from Super Neighborhood/management district boundaries
houston.consumerRationale: Recognizable central-west district with frequent event and arterial awareness needs.

houston.label: Medical Center / Rice
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from Super Neighborhood and TMC district boundaries
houston.consumerRationale: High-trip medical, university, and event corridor distinct from Montrose and Southwest Houston.

houston.label: Uptown / Galleria
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from Uptown management district and adjacent Super Neighborhood boundaries
houston.consumerRationale: Consumer-known shopping and employment center around West Loop and Westheimer.

houston.label: Memorial
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from Memorial Super Neighborhood/management district sources with enclave decisions documented
houston.consumerRationale: Well-known west Houston corridor along I-10, Memorial Drive, and Beltway 8.

houston.label: Spring Branch
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from Spring Branch Super Neighborhood group
houston.consumerRationale: Commonly recognized area between I-10, US 290, Beltway 8, and the inner northwest.

houston.label: Energy Corridor
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from Energy Corridor management district plus Houston-owned adjacent frontage
houston.consumerRationale: Major employment and I-10 west commuting corridor distinct from Katy.

houston.label: Westchase / West Houston
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from Westchase district and Super Neighborhood boundaries
houston.consumerRationale: Recognizable west-side activity and commute area along Beltway 8, Westpark, and Westheimer.

houston.label: Northwest Houston
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from Super Neighborhood groups clipped against separate Harris communities
houston.consumerRationale: Broad but consumer-understandable northwest Houston area without absorbing Cypress or Jersey Village.

houston.label: North Houston / Greenspoint
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from Greater Greenspoint/Northside Super Neighborhood boundaries with separate-community precedence
houston.consumerRationale: Separates I-45/Greenspoint awareness from inner Heights and far-north communities.

houston.label: Northeast Houston
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from northeast Super Neighborhood groups with Ship Channel community exclusions
houston.consumerRationale: Recognizable northeast Houston ownership without leaking into separately configured lake/ship-channel communities.

houston.label: East End
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from Greater East End management district and Super Neighborhood boundaries
houston.consumerRationale: Consumer-friendly east-inner Houston area around I-45, Harrisburg, Navigation, and Wayside.

houston.label: Southeast Houston / Hobby
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from Hobby-area Super Neighborhoods and airport district context
houston.consumerRationale: Major airport and I-45/Gulf Freeway region distinct from Pasadena and Clear Lake.

houston.label: Southwest Houston
houston.geometryStrategy: LP035.1 polygon from southwest Super Neighborhood groups clipped to Harris/Houston ownership
houston.consumerRationale: Large recognized southwest Houston area along US 59, Beltway 8, and Brays Bayou.
